command:. .gnomish/lib/task-change.sh
[ -f "$change/proposal.md" ] || { echo "$record names change '$change_name', but $change/proposal.md does not exist - write the change there, or name the active change the task is about"; exit 1; }
verdict=$(sed -n 's/^Verdict:[[:space:]]*//p' "$record" | head -1)
if [ "$verdict" != "no-blocking-dependencies" ]; then
  echo "the change record's verdict is '$verdict'; the only verdict that finishes this stage is 'no-blocking-dependencies'."
  echo "If the change IS blocked, do not finish the round: write the dependency chain to the path in \$GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE as {\"question\": \"...\", \"options\": [\"...\"]}, delete $record and end your turn."
  exit 1
fi

findings.message: Two abbreviation matches are dropped without notice. The proposal's BREAKING note, FR8, M3 and the location-search 'Search by abbreviation' scenario list only eight removed abbreviations (ET, PT, ALMT, ICT, SGT, GST, BRT, ART). The current table in packages/client/src/adapters/city-search/timeZoneAbbreviations.ts also has `GMT: ["UTC", "Europe/London"]` and `BST: ["Europe/London", "Asia/Dhaka"]`. With the tzdb table, GMT no longer finds the UTC zone (its tzdb abbreviation is UTC) and BST no longer finds Dhaka (tzdb designation `+06`). The proposal, spec and tests must state and cover these losses.

The glossary entry 'Wall-time hint' in docs/glossary/date-selection.md is not updated, although this change rewrites its text and its owner's input. The entry's RU example is «01:30 бывает дважды — показано первое (UTC−4)»; the change makes it «(EDT, UTC−4)» (FR7, time-selection delta) and adds zoneAbbreviationLabel/isZoneAbbreviationShown to presentWallTimeHint. .claude/rules/glossary.md: 'A change that shifts a term's meaning, owner or Russian name updates the entry in the same change.' Task 1.1 covers time.md, locations.md, settings.md and search.md only.

Parts of NFR-A1 and UX2 have no automated test. The 'Accessible zone label' requirement says each toggle 'MUST be at least 44 × 44 px' and 'keep a visible focus outline', and UX2 promises 'no layout jump of the toggles'. Task 9.2's E2E scenarios cover only names and pressed state, the keyboard, axe-core and the one-row layout. Task 7.3 checks only the check icon. The 44 px size and min-h-11 appear only in design D7. tasks.md must name an automated test for every promise in the proposal, e.g. an E2E step like the existing 'every settings option is at least 44 px high' in settings_e2e.feature.
